description: This Java source file defines the class M4, which represents a 4x4 float matrix used for graphical transformations. It includes methods for creating a copy, multiplying matrices, applying the matrix to a vertex, and setting the matrix to the identity; along with a toString implementation for display.

classes.name: M4
